text:
I’m a passionate, hard-working freelancer with 7 years of experience building polished digital products and working across full stack web development. I’ve also supported brands and startups by translating product value into clear, professional experiences that are easy to understand and use.

For this project, I’d be excited to help create a clean, modern logo and a simple branding kit that feels aligned with a customer engagement platform serving businesses through SMS, WhatsApp, email, and similar channels. I understand the importance of brand identity in a SaaS environment: it needs to look trustworthy, scalable, and memorable, while also working well across sales materials, pitch decks, and proposals.

My background includes extensive experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. While my core background is in product and web development, I’m very comfortable collaborating on visual systems and ensuring brand assets are practical across digital use cases.

One relevant project was Embedded customer analytics for a confidential B2B SaaS client. I built usage dashboards embedded in a SaaS product so each customer account could see its own metrics. That work rolled out to 140 customer accounts and was delivered 3 weeks early. It required a strong sense of product consistency, clarity, and presentation, which translates well into building branding materials that need to feel cohesive across multiple touchpoints.

For this logo and branding kit, I can help shape a simple but flexible identity system that includes:
- Logo direction and refinement
- Brand template and basic guideline structure
- A universal PowerPoint template for sales, pitching, and proposals

I’d aim for something professional, modern, and adaptable, with enough structure to keep the brand consistent without making it feel rigid. I’m also comfortable working with clear feedback and iterating quickly to arrive at a polished result.

If you’re looking for someone who is reliable, detail-oriented, and focused on creating a brand foundation that supports growth, I’d be glad to help.
